title.th: ผมไปซื้อของ

learning_goals: Answer four questions and write three sentences.

sentences.th: วันนี้ผมไปตลาด
sentences.en: Today I go to the market.

sentences.th: ผมอยากซื้อน้ำและกล้วย
sentences.en: I want to buy water and bananas.

sentences.th: น้ำหนึ่งขวดราคาสิบบาท
sentences.en: One bottle of water costs ten baht.

sentences.th: ผมซื้อน้ำสองขวด
sentences.en: I buy two bottles of water.

sentences.th: กล้วยหนึ่งถุงราคายี่สิบบาท
sentences.en: One bag of bananas costs twenty baht.

sentences.th: ผมซื้อกล้วยหนึ่งถุง
sentences.en: I buy one bag of bananas.

sentences.th: ผมจ่ายเงินสี่สิบบาท
ผมกลับบ้าน

language_notes.en: Prices are fictional learning examples, not current market prices. Two bottles at 10 baht plus one bag at 20 baht total 40 baht.
language_notes.zh-TW: 價格為虛構的學習例子，不代表目前市價。兩瓶水各十泰銖，加一袋香蕉二十泰銖，共四十泰銖。

language_notes.en: Thai commonly counts things using noun + number + classifier.
language_notes.zh-TW: 泰語常用「名詞＋數字＋量詞」計算物品。

vocabulary_notes.en: Seven priority entries are marked for focused study. Supporting words and numbers can be reviewed gradually. Previously encountered refers to earlier lesson vocabulary, not mastery.
vocabulary_notes.zh-TW: 七個重點詞供集中學習。其他輔助詞與數字可逐步複習。「曾接觸」不代表已熟練。

pronunciation.reading_advice_en: Read the Thai story first, then practise these meaningful groups. Romanized school readings are not supplied in this draft. ก = k.

notes.note_en: Read this quantity group as two bottles of water.

notes.th: กล้วยหนึ่งถุง
notes.note_en: Read this quantity group as one bag of bananas.

notes.th: สิบ / ยี่สิบ / สี่สิบ
notes.note_en: Practise recognizing ten, twenty, and forty.
Recognize this group as pay money.
The title uses this common group for shopping or buying things.

sentence_patterns.pattern_th: ผม + ซื้อ + item
sentence_patterns.explanation_en: Place the item after ซื้อ.
ขวด counts bottles; ถุง counts bags. Keep one whole phrase together.

examples.th: ผมซื้อน้ำสองขวด
examples.en: I buy two bottles of water.

sentence_patterns.pattern_th: item + quantity + ราคา + amount + บาท
sentence_patterns.explanation_en: ราคา introduces the price. These prices belong to the fictional story.

examples.th: กล้วยหนึ่งถุงราคายี่สิบบาท
examples.en: One bag of bananas costs twenty baht.

comprehension.question_th: วันนี้ผมไปไหน
comprehension.hint_en: ไปไหน means go where.

choices.th: ไปโรงเรียน

comprehension.explanation_en: วันนี้ผมไปตลาด says I go to the market.

comprehension.question_th: ผมซื้อน้ำกี่ขวด
comprehension.question_en: How many bottles of water do I buy?
comprehension.hint_en: กี่ขวด means how many bottles.
comprehension.explanation_en: ผมซื้อน้ำสองขวด says two bottles.

comprehension.question_th: กล้วยหนึ่งถุงราคาเท่าไร
comprehension.question_en: How much does one bag of bananas cost?
comprehension.hint_en: ราคาเท่าไร asks how much something costs.
comprehension.explanation_en: The story gives a price of ยี่สิบบาท: twenty baht.

comprehension.question_th: ผมจ่ายเงินกี่บาท
comprehension.question_en: How many baht do I pay?
comprehension.hint_en: กี่บาท asks how many baht.
comprehension.explanation_en: Two bottles at ten baht plus one bag at twenty baht: 2 × 10 + 20 = 40 baht.

writing.instructions_en: Translate the prompts into Thai before checking the suggested answers. Other appropriate answers may also be valid.

prompts.en: I buy two bottles of water.
prompts.suggested_answer_th: ผมซื้อน้ำสองขวด
ผมจ่ายเงินสี่สิบบาท

writing.personalization_en: Write two true sentences using this lesson’s patterns. Adapt the example situation to your own life.
writing.pronoun_note_en: The narrator uses ผม. Use ฉัน or another suitable self-reference when appropriate.

tasks.instruction_en: Read all eight sentences aloud slowly.
Hide the story and say three sentences using this lesson’s vocabulary.

speaking.optional_task_en: Record a short voice memo and compare it with a later attempt.

study_schedule.task_en: Read the Thai story, then check translations.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 先讀泰語故事，再查看翻譯。

study_schedule.task_en: Review the seven focus words and reading notes.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 複習七個重點詞和閱讀筆記。

study_schedule.task_en: Complete four comprehension questions and three writing prompts.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 完成四道理解題和三道寫作練習。

study_schedule.task_en: Read aloud and retell the story in your own words.
study_schedule.task_zh-TW: 朗讀，並用自己的話重述故事。
